name: Wodenstam
description: Wodenstam was a world located within the star system of the same name, a part of the Outer Rim Territories' Skine sector. Around 10 ABY, it served as the homeworld of Lucross Collections, a loan sharking and credit laundering operation and member of the criminal Tenloss Syndicate.
